The pattern established shows: calculate total (50 seats), calculate half (25), then state remaining count — the answer must state 20 seats remaining (50×60% = 30 of 50).

Final token "30." ends the calculated answer count (30 seats already filled), immediately constraining the next token to state the remaining seats: "The remaining 20 seats are empty" or similar phrasing completing the remainder calculation: 50 − 20 = 30 remaining empty seats.
